critical_code_review_comments: admin_data.py — clean separation of ALLOWED_COLLECTIONS vs PROTECTED_COLLECTIONS. Protected set covers all 7 spec-required keys. Peek correctly excludes password_hash via projection AND strips _id before serialization. Bulk-delete writes an audit_logs entry (best-effort). Users wipe injects {role: {$ne: admin}} guard — verified admin@lumo.test survives wipe in test.
admin_data.py:delete_one — falls back to ObjectId lookup if id-string match fails. Good defensive pattern.

App.js — catch-all order is correct: /admin/* before /*. Combined with Protected wrapper this naturally funnels unauthenticated /admin/* to /signin, and authenticated bogus paths to / — exactly matches spec.

MapPage.jsx — useMemo on grouped pins (re-groups on pins change only). Empty 'remote' group is correctly omitted when no remote jobs exist. Heading 'Grouped by type & category' has uppercase CSS class so Playwright inner_text returns 'GROUPED BY TYPE & CATEGORY' (false-negative when searching for 'Grouped by'). Source text correct.
NavBar.jsx — mobile-subnav uses md:hidden so it's hidden on ≥768px viewports (verified). Sheet closes after navigation via React state change in MarketplacesSheet.
DataManagementTab.jsx — typed confirm uses case-insensitive match (collection.toLowerCase()) — good UX. Older-than Input is optional. Wipe button disabled when count=0 — good.
